FACT.d: Fertilizers and Chemicals Travancore Limited produces nitrogenous fertilizers and caprolactam for agricultural and industrial use. It is a state-owned enterprise under the Government of India.

FAZE3Q.d: Faze Three Limited manufactures and exports home textile products, specializing in bath mats, rugs, and automotive textiles. Its primary customers are major global home furnishing retailers and brands.

FCL.d: Fineotex Chemical manufactures specialty chemicals used in textile processing, water treatment, and cleaning industries. It supplies auxiliary chemicals and functional solutions to textile manufacturers globally.

FDC.d: FDC manufactures and markets formulation and active pharmaceutical ingredients across various therapeutic segments. Its products are sold to hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies primarily in India and international markets.

FEDERALBNK.d: The Federal Bank Limited provides commercial banking and financial services. It serves retail, corporate, and agricultural customers primarily through its branch network across India.

FIEMIND.d: Fiem Industries manufactures automotive lighting, signaling equipment, and rear-view mirrors. Its primary customers are major two-wheeler and four-wheeler original equipment manufacturers in India.

FILATEX.d: Filatex India manufactures polyester multi-filament yarns, including POY, FDY, and texturised yarn. Its products are supplied to textile manufacturers for weaving and knitting fabrics.

FINEORG.d: Fine Organic Industries manufactures specialty chemicals, focusing on oleochemical-based emulsifiers for food, cosmetics, and plastics. It serves global food and industrial manufacturers.

FINKURVE.d: Finkurve Financial Services Limited operates as a non-banking financial company offering loans and credit solutions. It primarily serves small and medium enterprises with working capital financing.

FINOPB.d: Fino Payments Bank provides digital financial services, savings accounts, and remittance services. It primarily targets underbanked customers and rural segments through a merchant-led distribution network.

FINPIPE.d: Finolex Industries Limited manufactures PVC pipes and fittings along with PVC resin. Its products serve agricultural, plumbing, and industrial markets across India.

FIRSTCRY.d: Brainbees Solutions operates the FirstCry platform, retailing mother, baby, and kids products through online channels and physical stores. It serves retail consumers across India.

FIVESTAR.d: Five-Star Business Finance Limited provides small business loans and mortgage loans to micro-entrepreneurs and self-employed individuals. The company operates primarily in semi-urban and rural areas across India.

FLAIR.d: Flair Writing Industries manufactures and distributes writing instruments and stationery products, including pens, ballpoints, and calculators. Its customers include retail consumers and corporate clients across domestic and international markets.

FLUOROCHEM.d: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Limited manufactures specialty fluoropolymers, fluorochemicals, and refrigerants used in industrial applications. Its products serve automotive, aerospace, and electrical end markets globally.

FORCEMOT.d: Force Motors manufactures light commercial vehicles, multi-utility vehicles, engines, and agricultural tractors. Its customers include fleet operators, transport businesses, and retail buyers.

FORTIS.d: Fortis Healthcare operates a network of multi-specialty hospitals, diagnostics centers, and day-care specialty facilities across India. It provides tertiary and quaternary healthcare services to retail and institutional patients.

FOSECOIND.d: Foseco India Limited manufactures specialized foundry consumable products and foundry solutions. The company serves metal casting industries by supplying products that improve the quality of ferrous and non-ferrous metal castings.
